not_met.question: Q6
not_met.lacks: The developer of the generator writes each point it found open into the Making record, as rn/architecture.md:369-370 says. The developer of tree.py decides the points open for the main conversation, as rn/architecture.md:313 says. They can't join a point found in a turn to the other data the same way. Point joins only the Change that settles it and the one Decision it stands for while open, as rn/images/data-model.svg:124 draws. No join links a Point to the Making record, to the Answers, which hold no found point by rn/architecture.md:371-372, or to the Result that names it. A point the design leaves open has no Decision in the tree yet, so the two developers can't tell whether it reaches the Point through the round's records, through the Result, or by first becoming a Decision.
